lines: Resonating wishes now awaken
For a future I won't give up
Beyond the fate that brought us to meet
This longing shines
I've tried entrusting my longing to a future that isn't here
Still searching for the true meaning of strength
The meaning of accepting pain just as it is
I learned it from you, running on toward tomorrow
The passing scenery now flows by
Beyond the world I've drawn toward me
Feeling the pouring signals through my body
Releasing everything, now
Just truth in my heart
I'll never waver, not ever
Because there's a longing that can't be erased
Unraveling the truth, never turning my eyes away
I'll reach the next stage to realize all
Your back as you ran once felt so far away
Since when have you felt this close to me?
Unable to hide my fear, I looked up at the looming sky
These wounded memories, someday I'll overcome them
My yearning now awakens my power
Because there's something I want to protect
Holding the passing scenery in my chest, I just keep climbing
The pain vanishes into the wind
Believe in Judgelight
Shooting through even fate itself
Let's forge the dawn with these hands
With the courage to change and a heart that never will
I believe myself and precious emotion
Shattering everything with this longing
In the light of the beginning, we swear our oath
To judge the endless darkness
I feared drowning in the whirlpool of loneliness
But I won't look back anymore
The passing scenery now flows by
Beyond the world I've drawn toward me
Feeling the pouring signals through my body
Releasing everything, now
Just truth in my heart
I'll never waver, not ever
Because there's a longing that can't be erased
Unraveling the truth, never turning my eyes away
I'll reach the next stage to realize all
Believing in a bond that's sure
